label: 🏙 Boundary by US city
description: Look up the WKB boundary of a US Place (Incorporated Place or Census Designated Place) from a city name, "City, ST" combo, or lat/lon point. The bundled boundary is APPROXIMATE — an equal-area circle around the centroid sized by the gazetteer's true land area. Use for marker-style city maps or rough choropleth; supplement with TIGER Place shapefiles for pixel-accurate boundaries.

input_mode.label: Input mode
enumLabels: auto · try text first, fall back to point

input_column.label: City column
input_column.help: Column with a US city name ("Boise") or a "City, ST" combo ("Boise, ID"). Names are case-insensitive. Ambiguous names like "Springfield" return the largest match unless qualified with state.
